page: City page: B2B lead generation Abu Dhabi (/b2b-lead-generation-abu-dhabi)

items.question: Does Myntmore have an office in Abu Dhabi?
items.answer: No. Myntmore's only office is in BKC, Mumbai, and every engagement runs remotely. Abu Dhabi companies work with us over calls, a shared dashboard and a weekly report, the same way our clients in other cities do. This page describes the Abu Dhabi market we serve, not a local branch.

items.question: How is outreach in Abu Dhabi different from Dubai?
items.answer: Abu Dhabi has fewer, larger buyers, many of them government-linked groups with formal procurement. That favours account-based outreach to a defined list of companies and several roles in each, rather than high-volume cold email. Dubai suits higher volumes across more, smaller companies.

items.question: Which Abu Dhabi buyers is this built for?
items.answer: Suppliers to energy, industrial and infrastructure groups, healthcare and life sciences companies, and IT, fintech and professional services firms selling into ADGM, Hub71 and the wider capital. Related UAE work includes 20 employee benefits meetings for an insurer and 16 managed IT meetings. The system adapts to any B2B ICP.

items.question: Can outreach get us onto a vendor list or a tender?
items.answer: Not directly. Outreach does not replace vendor registration or a tender response. What it does is start conversations with the people who own a requirement, so that when registration or a tender opens, they already know you. It also tells you early which buyers have a live need, so your team can prepare before the formal process starts.

items.question: Can you help an Indian company find clients in Abu Dhabi?
items.answer: Yes. We build separate sending infrastructure, write copy that reads as native to UAE buyers and send in their working hours, so your main domain is never at risk and messages arrive when buyers are at their desks. Our UAE campaigns include managed IT services, employee benefits insurance and pharma distribution partners.

items.question: How quickly can we expect meetings to start?
items.answer: Campaigns go live within 18 days of kickoff, and most clients see their first qualified conversations in weeks 3 to 4. The first two weeks go into ICP mapping, list building, sending domains with warm-up, and copy. Meeting volume usually becomes consistent by weeks 6 to 8, once messaging is tuned on real replies.

items.question: What does pricing look like?
items.answer: We work on a monthly retainer with a 3-month minimum, which covers setup and enough sending to judge results. After that it runs month to month with 30 days' notice, with no annual contract. We don't publish a price list; we share a quote after a free GTM audit call, once we know which channels you need.

items.question: What do you need from us to get started?
items.answer: A clear picture of your ICP (even a rough one works), access to a domain we can set up for outbound sending, and about an hour of your time for an onboarding call. We handle ICP refinement, list building, sequence writing, and day-to-day campaign management from there.
